name: Studio Field Atlas
summary: A wall-scale research identity that makes a question, a small set of findings and their evidence readable at a distance.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style PosterLead.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style PosterNote.

recognitionRules: Use large Avenir headings with plain Arial supporting text.
Organize the poster around the research question before individual findings.
Keep source labels close to the corresponding evidence.
Use the source cyan geometric strip with plum, near-black and mint circle/wedge/square forms above three reading columns; keep body copy black on white.

principles: Move from observation to interpretation to a bounded next question.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Make the question visible. Let the evidence gather around it.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid “proves” when the material only supports a hypothesis.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: A record suggests a direction; it does not speak for every person.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use STUDIO FIELD ATLAS in Avenir with a small atlas number and one long rule. No map or globe icon.
invariants: Use large Avenir headings with plain Arial supporting text.
Organize the poster around the research question before individual findings.
Keep source labels close to the corresponding evidence.
adaptations: A digital excerpt keeps the research question and source note.
A larger poster adds whitespace before adding more findings.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Avenir Next is a separately licensed Apple/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
